newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 17 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 17 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said on Wednesday that it qualified for bond insurance the following 17 municipal bond issues set for competitive sale.
--Pleasanton USD, Calif., $8.685 million and $7.315 million of GO bonds.
--Cottage Grove, Minn., $1.22 million GO improvement and $1.475 million sewer GOs.
--University of North Carolina at Greensboro $25.5 million in four issues of revenue bonds.
--Albuquerque, N.M., $46.7 million of water and sewer bonds.
--Dona Ana Br Comm, N.M., $3 million GOs.
--Newburgh City SD, N.Y., $3 million of GO school bonds.
--William Floyd UFSD, N.Y., $12.9 million of school district bonds.
--Commonwealth Transportation Board, Va., $33 million transportation revs. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
